lines.text: Many learners say: The bus is always in time.
Better: The bus is always on time.
On time means at the right time.
On time! The train is always on time.

data.wrong: The bus is always in time.
data.right: The bus is always on time.
data.why: On time means at the right time.
data.memory: The bus is always on time.

native.tip: Türkçede “zamanında” deriz; tam saatinde olmak için “on time” kullanılır: “The bus is always on time.”
native.caption: “The bus is always in time” mi diyorsun? 😅 Tam saatinde, gecikmeden demek için “in time” değil, “on time” kullanılır. Doğrusu “The bus is always on time.” Ama’yı dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.

en.tip: For the right time, use “on time”: “The bus is always on time.”
en.caption: Do you say “The bus is always in time”? 😅 In English for the right time we say on time, not in time. The right sentence is “The bus is always on time.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
